assertions: Five native fields, default/value/copy construction, mutation, clone, equality and original hash fold are retained.
Actual Writer history, browser snapshots and ODT font declarations preserve complete supported font metadata.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task135 preserves the five native SvxFontItem fields and original value defaults/constructors/copies/setters/equality/hash using existing SAL/o3tl. Writer state and ODF consumers use the single shared value owner; browser presentation and resource aliases stay at their existing boundaries. Native Any FontDescriptor, localized presentation, full font/device/config services and Calc DocPool/document/UI/ODS remain pending. Existing status/history and conscious save/open/recovery deviations are retained; no broad parity promotion or custom lifetime engine.
